lessons_used: Predictions remain unreliable: high positive forecasts frequently overpredicted performance, while zero or negative forecasts repeatedly preceded strong wins.
Adding new screens at the finish stage (finish, new_screen) consistently hurt performance across 2 agreeing tests (-15.9% and -9.0%).
Redesigning the story stage (choose_path, redesign) was generally effective, yielding 3 winning tests (+7.6%, +5.7%, and +3.9%), though 1 test showed no clear effect.
Choose path copy updates (choose_path, copy) hurt performance in 2 agreeing tests (-3.0% and -3.7%), despite 1 winning test (+3.7%).
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) and sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) produced inconsistent outcomes, driving both strong wins (+2.5% to +6.7%) and severe losses (-4.5% to -9.5%).
Finish copy updates (finish, copy) showed no clear effect across both tests (+0.9% and +1.9%), and categories with fewer than 2 agreeing tests remain thin evidence.

candidates.title: Story Screen Compact Grid Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the story screen layout to a compact grid showcasing starter pet companion highlights before path choice.
candidates.why: Lessons show redesigning the story stage was effective (+7.6%, +5.7%, +3.9%). A compact layout reduces early drop-off and idling (mean 514s).

story.headline: Meet Your Future Desktop Companion
story.body: Choose how you want to discover, adopt, and bring your digital companion to life on your desktop.

guard.reason: Redesigns story screen while continuing to introduce the pet companion.

candidates.score_note: choose_path redesign is a strong historical performer (+3.9% avg, 3 winning tests), though initial drop-off at this step is low.

candidates.title: Story Screen Mascot Welcome Sub-Flow
candidates.change: Add an animated mascot greeting component and interactive sound preview to the story screen intro flow.
candidates.why: Enhances early narrative engagement at the story step where previous redesigns yielded strong gains.

guard.reason: Adds mascot sub-flow to story screen while retaining its core function.

candidates.score_note: Adding sub-flows and intro screens tends to add friction, and cost is high for interactive components.

candidates.title: Sign In Two Column Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign sign-in screen into a two-column layout highlighting cloud account linking and pet preservation.
candidates.why: Address top support complaint (8 emails) where users reported pets missing or reset after signing in with wrong accounts.

candidates.why: Adoption stage has a 21.2% drop-off rate and 89s median completion time; split layout provides clearer side-by-side companion comparison.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Companion
pick_friend.body: Compare companion personalities and traits side-by-side to find your perfect match.

guard.reason: Redesigns pick_friend to a split layout while still allowing pet choice.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has a 21.2% drop-off rate, but adoption redesigns have shown inconsistent historical performance (+0.8% avg).

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Trait Checklist Layout
candidates.change: Change adoption certificate layout to a checklist format displaying pet adoption parameters before final confirmation.
candidates.why: Improves clarity around adopted pet configuration before generation, reducing custom pet failures reported in support (3 emails).

adoption_certificate.headline: Confirm Pet Adoption Details
adoption_certificate.body: Review your companion's traits and preparation status before generation begins.

guard.reason: Replaces the official adoption certificate and stamp with a traits confirmation checklist, losing the certificate job.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Status Animation & Time Info
candidates.change: Enable time estimates and status animation components on the waiting screen during pet rendering.
candidates.why: Home stage waiting screen takes median 201s / mean 2336s; giving clear rendering feedback keeps users engaged during background setup.

guard.reason: Adds status animation and time estimate during the real wait on the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: home, wait_info has a solid track record (+2.2% across 7 tests) and directly addresses extreme home wait times via config.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Desktop Docking Hint
candidates.change: Add explicit hint text explaining that your pet will dock to your desktop taskbar once setup completes.
candidates.why: Support received multiple complaints (3 emails) about pets not showing on desktop or users thinking the app won't open.

waiting.hint: Once complete, your pet will appear directly on your desktop or system tray icon.

guard.reason: Adds informative desktop hint text on the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Supported by 3 user email complaints, but hint changes overall carry mixed/negative historical gains.

candidates.change: Add hint text on home intro explaining how to reveal, move, or open controls from the system tray icon.
candidates.why: Address post-onboarding confusion (3 emails) where users are unclear how to control or unhide their pet on desktop.

home_intro.hint: Click the pet icon in your desktop system tray anytime to show, hide, or open companion controls.

guard.reason: Adds system tray controls hint to home intro overlay.

candidates.score_note: Finish step loses 29.6% of users and has 3 support emails; cheap text update but finish hints historically show flat (+0.0%) lift.

candidates.change: Redesign home intro screen layout to spotlight mode with dedicated action buttons for launching pet desktop companion.
candidates.why: Finish step drop-off is high (29.6% drop) with median time 395s. A focused spotlight redesign clarifies immediate next actions.

guard.reason: Redesigns home_intro spotlight screen without violating any onboarding limits.
